SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 13:56:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

    upcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 01 and 02
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 01:43:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 22 and 23
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 22:03:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

                        (
                            case
                                when (
                                    product_type = 'Equity Swap'
                                        and maturity_date = '2025-05-29'
                                        and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0
                                    ) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                                when (
                                    product_type = 'Equity Swap'
                                        and maturity_date = '2025-05-29'
                                        and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0
                                    ) then 0
                                when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                                when (
                                    product_type = 'Convertible_bond'
                                        and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0
                                    ) then 0
                                when (
                                    product_type = 'Convertible_bond'
                                        and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0
                                    ) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                                else abacus_pv_base_ccy
                                end
                            ) as exposure
                 from risk_uat.rmv_position
                 where business_date = '2025-05-29'
                   and investment_dept = 'Active Equities'
                   and portfolio_type = 'IP'
                   and product_type in (
                                        'Common Stock',
                                        'Common Stock Private',
                                        'Convertible_bond',
                                        'Equity Swap',
                                        'Private Emerging Mkt Fund',

                     )
                   and scd_model_portfolio not in ('LCUSSST', 'LFTSSST', 'LHOSSST')
                   and long_short = 'LONG'),

select investment_strat as node_name,
       sum(exposure)    as long_pv
from ae_temp
group by investment_strat
union
select 'Total' as node_name,
       sum(exposure)   as long_pv

       long_pv,

SELECT

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 01 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 02 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 23:27:59'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT ds.* FROM ( select cast(st.business_date as date) as business_date,
	round(st.abor_transaction_number) as abor_transaction_number,
	st.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,
	es.isin,
	es.cusip,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	es.security_name_id,
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	st.model_portfolio_id,
	st.business_transaction_code,
	st.settlement_currency,
	cast(st.trade_date as date) as trade_date,
	cast(st.payment_date as date) as payment_date,
	st.nominal,
	st.nominal_basis,
	st.elementary_transaction_code,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_quotation_currency,
	st.interest_dividend_capital_event_portfolio_currency,
	st.transaction_cancellation_flag,
	st.reconciliation_status,
	st.created_date,
	ep.party_id,
	ep.epm_party_name,
	st.transaction_number_in_originating_system,
	st.payment_amount_quotation_currency,
	st.payment_amount_portfolio_currency,
	st.external_short_tag,
	st.settlement_date,
	st.quotation_currency,
	st.number_of_units,
	case when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') and st.abor_security_name like '%CAD%' then 'Y'
	when ss.abor_security_type_id in ('FXFORWARD','FXNDF','FXSPOT') then 'N'
	end cross_deal_indicator,
	st.settlement_location,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_exchange_country.country_name esm_country_name,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name esm_incorp_country_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	ss.abor_security_group_name,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name country_ref_name,
	rcc.currency_name quotation_currency_name,
	st.price price_qc,
	st.price * st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency price_pc,
	st.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.investment_type_name,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
	stc.abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
	st.portfolio_id,
	st.ibor_reason,
	ss.abor_coupon_rate,
	st.dividend_per_share,
	st.borrowing_account,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
	stc.coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
	stc.restitution_expected_settlement_currency
from (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_transaction_number_primary_key order by business_date desc) as rn
	from trades_deals.scd_transactions tr
	where transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
) st
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio )
	and st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by scd_party_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from party.enterprise_party
) ep
	on st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id
	and ep.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
	and ss.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities )
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and rec.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country
	on es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
	and rcc_exchange_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
	and rcc_incorp_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
	)sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes )
left join (
	select abor_transaction_number,
    		business_date,
    		transaction_cancellation_flag,
    		trade_date,
    		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
		max(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency else 0 end) abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Cost' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_portfolio_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_quotation_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
		sum(case when abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' then amount_settlement_currency else 0 end) restitution_expected_settlement_currency
 	from trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
 	group by abor_transaction_number,
    	business_date,
    	transaction_cancellation_flag,
    	trade_date
	) stc
	on st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
	and st.business_date = stc.business_date
	and st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag

SELECT  DISTINCT
    oe.dealcloud_opportunity_id, 
    oe.opportunity_deal_parent_id,
    oe.opportunity_deal_name,
    CASE WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Listed Real Assets' AND oe.deal_type = 'Listed Infrastructure' THEN 'Infra'
        WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Listed Real Assets' AND oe.deal_type = 'Listed Real Estate' THEN 'RE'
        WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Listed Real Assets' AND oe.deal_type = 'Listed SEG' THEN 'SEG'
        WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Sustainable Energies' THEN 'SEG'
        WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Infrastructure' THEN 'Infra'
        WHEN oe.cppib_group = 'Real Estate' THEN 'RE'
        END AS investment_group_short_name,
    oe.collaboration_groups, --to map
    oe.deal_sub_type as deal_type, --to map
    oe.status, oe.stage, --to map
    CASE WHEN oe.is_this_a_public_investment = 'No' THEN false
        ELSE true
        END AS public_deal,
    CASE WHEN oe.permissions_flag = 'All CPPIB' THEN false
        ELSE true
        END AS restricted_deal,
    oe.industry_vertical, --to map
    oe.sub_industry_vertical, --to map
    oe.primary_country,  -- to map
    oe.cppib_percent_ownership_pre_ipo as cppib_ownership,
    oe.investment_size_local as equity_check_millions_local,
    oe.investment_size_currency as equity_check_currency,
    oe.investment_partner,
    oe.investment_name_joint_venture,
    CASE WHEN id.reporting_name IS NOT null THEN id.reporting_name ELSE idp.reporting_name END AS reporting_name
FROM dealcloud_ra_opportunity_extract oe
    LEFT JOIN investran_real_asset_deals id 
        ON (oe.dealcloud_opportunity_id = CAST(id.dealcloud_opportunity_id AS INTEGER) 
            AND to_date(oe.date, 'yyyymmdd') = id.business_date) 
    LEFT JOIN investran_real_asset_deals idp 
        ON (oe.opportunity_deal_parent_id = CAST(idp.dealcloud_opportunity_id AS INTEGER) 
            AND to_date(oe.date, 'yyyymmdd') = idp.business_date)
WHERE oe.date='20250516'
    AND oe.deal_sub_type IS NOT null
    AND oe.investment_size_currency IS NOT null
    AND oe.opportunity_deal_name IS NOT null
    AND oe.status != 'Watchlist'

      union
  
      select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
      from ae_temp
      group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
  ) as q1
  right join analytics 
  on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
) "custom_sql_query"
  INNER JOIN (
  SELECT MAX((CASE WHEN (CAST(CAST("custom_sql_query"."business_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) < CAST('2025-05-30' AS DATE)) THEN CAST(CAST("custom_sql_query"."business_date" AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) END)) AS "x_measure__0",
    COUNT(1) AS "x__alias__0"
  FROM (
    with ae_temp as (
        select investment_dept, investment_strat, business_date,
               (case when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy
                     when (product_type = 'Equity Swap' and maturity_date = business_date and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then 0
                     when (product_type = 'Equity Swap') then abacus_notional_base_ccy + abacus_pv_base_ccy
                     when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0) then 0 
                     when (product_type = 'Convertible_bond' and abacus_notional_base_ccy <> 0) then abacus_pv_base_ccy

               ) as exposure

        where node in ('Active Equities','Asia','Europe','LatAm','North America','AE Enhanced Beta')
        and portfolio_type = 'IP' 
        and analytic_name in ('10 Year VaR', '10 Year Volatility','2 Year VaR', '2 Year Volatility','5 Year Expected Shortfall') 
        and (confidence_level is null or confidence_level = 0.95)
    )
    
    select q1.business_date, q1.node_name, q1.long_pv, analytics.analytic_name, analytics.analytic_value,
           (analytics.analytic_value / q1.long_pv) * 100 as "% analytics"
    from (
        select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_strat as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv
        from ae_temp
        group by ae_temp.investment_strat, ae_temp.business_date
    
        union
    
        select ae_temp.business_date, ae_temp.investment_dept as node_name, sum(ae_temp.exposure) as long_pv 
        from ae_temp
        group by ae_temp.investment_dept, ae_temp.business_date
    ) as q1
    right join analytics 
    on q1.business_date = analytics.business_date and q1.node_name = analytics.node
  ) "custom_sql_query"
  HAVING (COUNT(1) > 0)

WHERE ("custom_sql_query"."node_name" = 'AE Enhanced Beta')

		/* VALUE */

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

		from

		where

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level"

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)

	cross join unnest (

		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'

			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency

			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'

			when period = '5Y Rolling' then '6. 5Y Rolling'

		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

select a.*, b.*, c.*, d.country_name, e.currency_name, f.*, p.*, g.*, h.*, i.*
From 	
(
  select 
    id_model_portfolio,
    id_portfolio,
    cast(id_instrument as VARCHAR) as id_instrument_new,	
    instrument_id_type,	
    id_source_holding,	
    id_enterprise_holding,
    instrument_sub_group_code,
    instrument_sub_group_name,
    instrument_type_code,	
    instrument_type_name,	
    instrument_name_source,	
    current_nominal,
    current_nominal * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,
    current_clean_price,	
    clean_market_value,	
    book_value,	
    cost_value,	
    current_accrued_amount,	
    fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,	
    clean_market_value_pc,	
    cost_value_pc,	
    current_accrued_amount_pc,	
    quote_factor,	
    quote_type_description,	
    next_coupon_date_source,
    '2025-05-30' as business_date,
    abor_accrued_interest_pc as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
    abor_accrued_interest as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
    quoted_currency_code  as current_notional_currency,
    quoted_currency_code  as market_value_currency,
    quoted_currency_code	
  FROM holdings.commercial_paper_holdings_details t
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
    and ((Instrument_sub_group_code in ('ABCP') and Instrument_type_code in ('ABCP'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CP') and Instrument_type_code in ('TD','BA','BD','CP','GOVTB'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CPPIBCPIS') and Instrument_type_code in ('CPPIBCPIS'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CPPIBCP') and Instrument_type_code in ('CPPIBCP'))
    )
) as a
left Join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate,
    coupon_type,
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    null as putable_flag,
    null as sinkable_flag,
    null as convertible_flag,
    null as junior_flag,
    null as senior_flag,
    null as collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    delete_date
    --coupon_frequency_unit_source
  FROM asset.asset_money_market
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'

  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    CAST(issue_date AS VARCHAR) as issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate ,	
    coupon_type ,	
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    putable_flag,
    sinkable_flag,
    convertible_flag,
    junior_flag,
    senior_flag,
    collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    cast(delete_date AS VARCHAR) as delete_date
  FROM asset.asset_bonds
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
) as b
  on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new
left join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
    party_name, 
    bloomberg_company_id, 
    incorp_country_code,
    domicile_country_code
  FROM party.party
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
) as p
  on b.cppib_party_id_new=p.cppib_party_id_new3
left join	
(
  select	
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new2,	
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,	
    cppib_currency_code ,	
    cppib_currency_of_exposure_code

  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'

  on b.cppib_sec_id_new=c.cppib_sec_id_new2	
left join	
(
  select	
    country_code,	
    country_name	
  FROM reference.reference_country_codes
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'

  on c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=d.country_code

(
  select	
    currency_code,	
    currency_name	
  FROM reference.reference_currency_codes
  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'

  on c.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=e.currency_code

(

    id_model_portfolio, 
    unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code

  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'
) as f
  on a.id_model_portfolio = f.id_model_portfolio
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id,
    rating_value as inst_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_prod.cppib_security_rating
  where business_date = '2025-05-30'
    and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'

  on a.id_instrument_new = g.cppib_sec_id
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id,
    rating_value as issuer_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_prod.cppib_party_rating
  where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-05-30'

  on b.cppib_party_id_new = h.cppib_party_id

  where business_date = date'2025-05-30'

  on b.cppib_party_id_new = i.cppib_party_id

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 02
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-02 04:03:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* QuickSight b4e09673-2152-42a8-b610-37a0def5b821 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

SELECT * from (

                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end, 8) as mid_price, 
                format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot')
            UNION
            SELECT MainTable.to_currency as from_currency, 
                ROUND(case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price end, 8) as calc_mid_price, 
                format_datetime(MainTable.business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') as business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
            Left Join ( 
                SELECT case when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price else mid_price end as mid_price, business_date
                FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            ) as CAD_Rate on MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
            WHERE MainTable.business_date = (select max(business_date) from refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr where source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot') and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD' and MainTable.mid_price != 0 and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'

SELECT "business_date" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.business_date", "fiscal_quarter" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.fiscal_quarter", "department" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.department", "display_strategy" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.display_strategy", "level" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.level", "pv" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.pv", "vol_10yr" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.vol_10yr", "var_10yr" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.var_10yr", "es_10yr" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.es_10yr", "core_pool_aum" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.core_pool_aum", "pct_of_core" AS "096d05e5-14c0-4ce0-af8b-d54167bf797e.pct_of_core"
FROM (-- Final SQL: Department/Strategy/Program view with Core Pool AUM and % of core, filtered to dates after 2020-04-01

WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.*,
        date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar) || 'Q3'
            ELSE cast(year(date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar) || 'Q4'
        END AS fiscal_quarter_key
    FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics r
    WHERE r.portfolio_type = 'IP'
      AND r.hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
      AND r.hierarchy_level IN ('DEPARTMENT', 'STRATEGY', 'PROGRAM')
      AND (
            r.analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
            OR (
                r.analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
                AND r.confidence_level = 0.95
            )
        )
      AND date_parse(r.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= date '2020-04-01'
),

quarter_end_dates AS (
    SELECT fiscal_quarter_key, MAX(parsed_date) AS quarter_end_date
    FROM base_data
    WHERE month(parsed_date) IN (3, 6, 9, 12)
    GROUP BY fiscal_quarter_key
),

core_pool AS (
    SELECT 
        date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS parsed_date,
        SUM(market_value_qc) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM risk_prod.ref_fund_unitization
    WHERE fund_code = 'CORE'
    GROUP BY date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
),

filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        d.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date THEN 
                'F' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 3, 2) || ' ' || substr(d.fiscal_quarter_key, 5, 2)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS fiscal_quarter,
        cp.core_pool_aum
    FROM base_data d
    LEFT JOIN quarter_end_dates q 
        ON d.fiscal_quarter_key = q.fiscal_quarter_key AND d.parsed_date = q.quarter_end_date
    LEFT JOIN core_pool cp 
        ON d.parsed_date = cp.parsed_date
),

department_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM program_agg) AS "Radar Analytics_v2"

        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL')
),

department_final AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE 
            WHEN department IN ('Credit Investments', 'Private Equity', 'Real Assets') 
            THEN pv / NULLIF(core_pool_aum, 0)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS pct_of_core
    FROM department_agg
),

cppib_all_row AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS department,
        'CPPIB-ALL' AS display_strategy,
        'department' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        MAX(core_pool_aum) AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'DEPARTMENT'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter
),

strategy_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        CASE 
            WHEN strategy = 'Real_Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
            ELSE strategy
        END AS display_strategy,
        'strategy' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'STRATEGY'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, strategy
),

program_agg AS (
    SELECT
        parsed_date AS business_date,
        fiscal_quarter,
        COALESCE(department, 'CPPIB-ALL') AS department,
        program AS display_strategy,
        'program' AS level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS pv,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS vol_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS var_10yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' THEN analytic_value ELSE 0 END) AS es_10yr,
        NULL AS core_pool_aum,
        NULL AS pct_of_core
    FROM filtered
    WHERE hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    GROUP BY parsed_date, fiscal_quarter, department, program
)

-- Final output
SELECT * FROM department_final
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM cppib_all_row
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM strategy_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM program_agg) AS "Radar Analytics_v2"

SELECT aa.business_date,
                                aa.option_id,
                                aa.option_symbol,
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0 as strike,
                                aa.expiration_date,
                                aa.open_interest,
                                aa.call_put_flag,
                                aa.best_bid,
                                aa.best_ask,
                                aa.vega, 
                                bb.close_price as SpotRef, 
                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa
                                join market.om_security_price bb
                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date
                        where
                            aa.security_id = 110009
                            AND aa.business_date >= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND aa.business_date <= DATE '2025-05-30'
                            AND date_diff('day', aa.business_date, aa.expiration_date) > 5
                            AND aa.best_bid > 0
                            AND aa.best_ask > 0
                            AND aa.special_settlement_flag <> '1'
                            AND (
                                (aa.best_bid + aa.best_ask) / 2 >= CASE 
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)
                                END
                            )
                        ORDER BY 
                            business_date, expiration_date, call_put_flag, strike ASC
